name: insta-edits
description: Drive Instagram Edits for Mac from Claude Code with the full editor: keeps Claude's tool list in sync as Edits swaps 32 home tools for 274 editor tools, and keeps your token in the keychain.

edits_token.title: Edits access token
edits_token.description: In Edits: Settings > Automation > Enable Automation Server, then copy the Access token. Stored in your system keychain, never in a file or a chat.
